message.content:
<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
I'm back for my 5th work session. My last action was to book the meeting and ask Brad to send the confirmation email with a special note about the conflict.

The task is complete once the booking is created AND the confirmation email is sent. I've done my part, but I don't have confirmation from Brad that he has sent the email.

I should check the workspace to see if he has posted an update. There are no new entries since my last session.

This means I don't have positive confirmation that the task is complete. I cannot send email myself, so I am dependent on Brad.

What should I do?
1.  Assume Brad has done his part and end the task. This is risky. If he hasn't sent the email, the task isn't complete, and we might time out.
2.  Wait for Brad. I can just end my session and hope he adds an entry soon.
3.  Proactively check in with Brad. This seems like the most responsible thing to do. A quick message asking for confirmation will ensure we are on the same page and that the task is truly finished.

I will send a message to Brad asking him to confirm that the email has been sent. This is the only action I can take to move the task toward completion.

Plan:
1. Append a message to the workspace asking Brad for confirmation.
2. End the session.

function.name: append_workspace
function.arguments: {"text":"Hi Brad, just checking in. Have you sent the confirmation email to the partners for the Thursday 10:00 AM meeting? Let me know. Thanks, Alison."}
